BLOCKS.name: Block 1
BLOCKS.purpose: Build aerobic base, raise FTP floor with sweet spot and threshold work. Establish strength routine and cadence pattern.

BLOCKS.name: Block 2
BLOCKS.purpose: Raise the 5-min power ceiling — the direct limiter for your climb PR. VO2 intervals, over-unders, climb sims.

BLOCKS.name: Block 3
BLOCKS.purpose: Climb-specific variable efforts and race-pace work. Train the exact surge-recovery pattern of a mixed climb.

BLOCKS.name: Block 4
BLOCKS.purpose: Sharpen with short high-quality intervals, reduce volume, then PR attempt in France.

REST.name: Rest
REST.prescribed: Full rest. Walk, hydrate, sleep. Recovery IS training.

VO2_30_15.name: VO2 30/15 × 13
VO2_30_15.prescribed: 3 blocks of 13 × (30s @ 330W / 15s @ 150W), 4min recovery between blocks. Trainer or flat road only.

LONG_VO2.name: Long + VO2
LONG_VO2.prescribed: 2.5 hr Z2 with 4×4min VO2 in middle

RACE_2x8.name: Race Sim 2×8
RACE_2x8.prescribed: 🎯 Climb simulation: 2 × 8min @ 300-315W (target race power), 8min recovery. Pace evenly.

Z2_60_SPRINT.name: Z2 + Sprints
Z2_60_SPRINT.prescribed: 45min Z2 (145-180W, cad 88+) then 5 × 15sec ALL-OUT sprints in the last 15min. Rolling start, 3-4min full recovery between sprints.

STR_BW.name: Strength (bodyweight)
STR_BW.prescribed: Goblet sq 3×12, single-leg RDL 3×10, Bulgarian split sq 3×8, calf raises 3×15, side plank 3×30s

STR_GYM.name: Strength (heavy)
STR_GYM.prescribed: Sprint-prep: Back sq 4×4 @ 80-85% 1RM (2-3min rest), Bulgarian split sq w/ DB 3×6/side heavy, Barbell hip thrust 3×5 heavy, Explosive step-ups 3×5/side (fast), Plank 3×45s. Full recovery between sets.

CANNES_SHAKEOUT.name: Cannes Shakeout
CANNES_SHAKEOUT.prescribed: Sunday post-flight shakeout. Cannes seafront promenade, flat, cap 150W, HR ≤135. Light effort to wake the legs after travel.

CANNES_SUN_AM.name: Cannes Sun AM Z2
CANNES_SUN_AM.prescribed: 90min Z2 early ride (back by 11am). La Bocca → coast → Cap d'Antibes loop. Z2 (145-180W), cadence 88+, HR ≤140.

CANNES_Z2_LOCAL.name: Cannes Local Z2
CANNES_Z2_LOCAL.prescribed: 2 hours easy aerobic from La Bocca, scout local roads. Esterel coastal road or Mougins backroads. Z2 (145-180W), cadence 88+, HR ≤140. Sets up Tue Tanneron SS.

CANNES_TANNERON_SS.name: Col du Tanneron SS
CANNES_TANNERON_SS.prescribed: 5km warmup ride to Mandelieu base. 3 × 15min @ 240-260W (sweet spot) on the climb, easy roll back between. Cool-down ride home.

CANNES_TANNERON_AE.name: Col du Tanneron A-effort
CANNES_TANNERON_AE.prescribed: 🎯 Race-pace climb test. 1 × ~35-40min all-out ascent at 275-285W threshold. Same climb as Tuesday — direct A/B comparison.

CANNES_VENCE_SS.name: Col de Vence SS
CANNES_VENCE_SS.prescribed: Ride to Vence base (~35km easy Z2). 3 × 15min @ 240-260W (sweet spot) on the climb, easy roll back between. Ride back to La Bocca. Fuel 60g carbs/hr.

CANNES_ESTEREL.name: Esterel Long
CANNES_ESTEREL.prescribed: 4-5 hour endurance: Cannes → coast west → Théoule → Esterel red rocks → back. Z2 base (165-180W), climbs drift to Z3/threshold briefly. Fuel like a race: 60g carbs/hr.
